title: Kareri Lake Trek
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.
highlights: Trek to Kareri Lake (about 13 km) along Nyund Nallah
Overnight camping at the lake campsite
Leisure time by the riverside in Kareri Village
overview:
A weekend trek near Dharamshala: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** Kareri Lake Trek leaves Delhi late in the evening by tempo traveller. The overnight route runs via Chandigarh, Una and Kangra, with a short dinner halt on the way.

Day 1 arrives near Dharamshala and drives on to Kareri Village, where you check in to a basic homestay and have the day at leisure. Day 2 is the trek to Kareri Lake, about 13 km along Nyund Nallah, ending with a night in camps. Day 3 starts with an early morning at the lake, then the descent to Kareri Village and an evening departure for Delhi. AC transport, one night in a homestay, one night in a camp and a trip coordinator are included. Prices start at ₹7,199 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The tempo traveller leaves Delhi late in the evening and travels overnight via Chandigarh, Una and Kangra. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.

faqs.q: How much does the Kareri Lake Trek cost?
faqs.a: ₹7,199 per person on quad sharing, ₹7,399 on triple sharing and ₹7,599 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.
AC transportation from Delhi to Delhi, 1 night in a homestay, 1 night in a camp, sightseeing as per the itinerary, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, a trip coordinator and 24x7 support.
The trek from Kareri Village to Kareri Lake is about 13 km along Nyund Nallah on Day 2. You camp near the lake that night and descend to Kareri Village on Day 3.
The first night is in a basic homestay in Kareri Village and the second night is in camps at the end of the trek to Kareri Lake. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
